title: Internal Verdicts Track Evidence: A Template-Controlled Neutrosophic Reading of Epistemic States in Large Language Models via the Jacobian Lens
abstract: arXiv:2611.18602v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: For twenty-five years, neutrosophic logic has assigned independent degrees of truth (T), indeterminacy (I), and falsity (F) to epistemic states that classical and fuzzy semantics cannot express. Previous applications measured these components on outputs: answers, judgments, expert evaluations. This paper reports, to our knowledge, the first neutrosophic reading of components inside the internal representations of a large language model. Using the recently released Jacobian lens on Qwen3.5-4B, we project intermediate-layer readouts onto lexicons of support, refutation, and hedging, obtaining layer-wise (T, I, F) profiles under conflicting evidence, first-person false belief, and factual control (n = 20 each). A first battery yielded three striking signatures: a surge of refutation mass under conflict, sustained indeterminacy under false belief, and an apparent "verdict collapse" before the output layer. translated_title: 内部判定追踪证据：通过雅可比透镜对大语言模型认知状态进行模板控制的中智逻辑解读
translated_abstract: 二十五年来，中智逻辑为经典语义学和模糊语义学无法表达的认知状态赋予独立的真(T)、不确定(I)、假(F)程度。以往的应用都是在输出层面测量这些成分：答案、判断、专家评估。据我们所知，本文首次在大语言模型的内部表征中读取中智成分。利用最近发布的雅可比透镜，在Qwen3.5-4B模型上，我们将中间层的读出投影到支持、反驳和保守措辞的词库上，在冲突证据、第一人称错误信念和事实对照条件下（各n=20）获得逐层的(T, I, F)轮廓。第一组实验产生了三个引人注目的特征：冲突条件下反驳质量的激增、错误信念条件下持续的不确定性，以及输出层之前出现的明显“判定崩塌”。第二组模板控制的实验……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次利用雅可比透镜在大语言模型内部表征中读取中智逻辑的真(T)、不确定(I)、假(F)三成分，发现冲突证据下反驳质量激增、错误信念下不确定性持续、以及输出层前出现“判定崩塌”等关键特征。
en_tdlr: This paper reports the first neutrosophic reading of truth (T), indeterminacy (I), and falsity (F) components inside LLM internal representations via the Jacobian lens, revealing signatures such as refutation mass surges under conflicting evidence, sustained indeterminacy under false belief, and an apparent "verdict collapse" before the output layer.
